theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_etp_cusp
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (Z : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a : Euclid P) (m : ℝ), a ∈ Q → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ y ∈ Z, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → unitBallVolume 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ 2) ≤ μ (ball y ρ)) → (∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun j => (lams (φ j))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x, g (dilation a (lams (φ j)) x) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (m * ∫ x in (Q : Set (Euclid P)), g x ∂μHE[2]))) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ ∀ x ∈ Z, dist x a < s → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ ≤ ε * dist x a
